_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil at score 63 with no breaker (momentum ~50, funding flat, no range break); base rate favors HOLD until a clear thrust or flush appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative silent on forward phase so no conflict—consensus follows analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 63-70 and 30d momentum stays near 50 with no range break or funding expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum lifts through ~70 with funding and ETF flows expanding (up into Optimism), or price/F&G breaks under 55 while exchange netflow stays extreme (down into Disbelief)
